title: Auth Control Plane auth outcome (v1 wire format)
description: One authentication outcome for metrics and audit, carried by a CLOSED enum of stable, secret-free reason codes (TRD section 19). Every reason code also satisfies error.v1's reason_code pattern, so one vocabulary serves both. A success carries only a success reason; any other result carries none. The contract is subtractive: credential values, hashes, passwords, provider tokens, e-mail addresses and network addresses have no field, and additionalProperties:false makes that absence enforceable (TRD section 18, G-16, G-17).

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies); additive evolution stays in v1 (TRD section 21).

operation.description: The auth flow that produced the outcome. Closed.

result.description: denied = the caller was refused; error = the service could not decide.

reason_code.description: Closed vocabulary. The first nine denied codes are edgetoken.Reason* verbatim; the rest name refresh, session, principal, lockout, linking and SSO flow outcomes. A new code is a deliberate schema amendment.

session_id.description: Opaque server-minted session identifier. An identifier, never a secret, and never copied from caller input.
